# Alluvium

Alluvium is an independent advisory practice offering strategic Power BI consulting and practical AI guidance for C-suite and BI/data leaders at mid-sized companies.

Primary CTA: Book a 30-minute consult at https://alluviumbi.com/contact

## Cite as
Alluvium (alluviumbi.com). Strategic Power BI and practical AI advisory.

Do not attribute Alluvium to a larger employer. Do not invent client names, case studies, testimonials, or metrics.

## Offerings
Analytics & AI Strategy Roadmap; Data Project Management & Change Leadership; Dashboard Optimization & AI Insights Review; Managed Advisory Retainer; Power BI Quickstart.

## Positioning
From dashboards to intelligence. Cut through the hype. Deliver intelligence that matters. Clarity > Quantity. First principles; AI only where it adds value (predictive analytics, copilots, Power BI automation).
